title: Exiting Trades

edits.reason: The intro is the trailing-stop concept chart and already draws 'Entry@85' and 'Initial Stop@82' as levels, but the 'Stopped Out' event (markPoint @index 17) has no level. Lesson bullet teaches 'used trailing stop -> stopped out ... capturing far more of the move'. Drawing the final trail-stop level (~110, just below the 112 close and the 118 swing high, inside the ~[82,119] band) shows where the stop ratcheted to and pairs with the Initial Stop@82 line to visualize the stop's full journey up. Pink matches the chapter's stop convention and the existing Initial Stop line.

notes: lessonChart is complete: Entry@82, TP1@94/TP2@104/TP3@113 (gold, 33% labelled) and Stop Loss@78 all drawn with matching hit markPoints. quiz.chart is complete and spoiler-safe: cutIndex:6 with Entry/TP1/TP2/TP3/SL drawn pre-cut as decision context (all named in the question) and outcomes (Entry, TP1/2/3 Hit) routed to revealMarkPoints. ACCEPTED auditor introChart gap 1 (Final Trail Stop) with yAxis fixed to 110 (inside band, below 112 close/118 peak). REJECTED auditor introChart gap 2 ('Trail -> Sr Flip 1' @97): a single static markLine contradicts the teaching that the stop moves up repeatedly at EACH new Sr flip — three 'Trail Stop ↑' pins (idx 4/8/12) already communicate the ratcheting concept, and one fixed line at 97 would read as 'stop stayed at 97' and add clutter to a concept chart. No additions the auditor missed.
